segments.text: Ok so this is the Tool Call Rendering page for Google Antigravity on React Native, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
This is the problem, the tools list has three tools that are never shown, and the prompt and build helper are missing too.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
This part wasn't on the page, so umm, I added the missing tools and the prompt myself.
Moving on to the demo. With those added, the weather card shows up, but as published the agent file just fails on import.
So basically, the agent should expose these tools so the cards render, but half of them aren't defined, so the server never starts as written.
That's the problem here, please have a look.
